description: 乐枢桌面本机状态：按身份隔离的偏好、草稿、传输记录与经过签名校验的程序更新，不保存业务主表、权限或登录令牌。
乐枢桌面公共控件：窗口、列表、表单和对话框，统一沿用未来药店的 AtomUI 视觉规范。

eIDAS (EU Regulation 910/2014) for SimpleSign: trust anchors from the EU list of trusted lists (LOTL, pivots followed), the qualification of signatures (QESig, QESeal, AdESig-QC… per ETSI TS 119 615 and TS 119 172-4), and eIDAS signing and validation policies.

A production-ready .NET Aspire template implementing Vertical Slice Architecture with feature folders, CQRS, MediatR, and PostgreSQL support. Includes best practices for clean architecture, domain-driven design, and scalable microservices.
The core of Masterly.NightShift: background jobs, the job server, retries and other filters, and the dashboard. Add a storage package such as Masterly.NightShift.SqlServer.
SQL Server storage for Masterly.NightShift background jobs, on Microsoft.Data.SqlClient. Creates and upgrades its own tables; Hangfire databases keep working.
In-memory storage for Masterly.NightShift background jobs, for development and tests. No dependencies; nothing survives the process.
BCL-only .NET protocol client for the nanosandbox helper (nanosb-protocol v1.0.0).
Redis storage for Masterly.NightShift background jobs, on StackExchange.Redis. Atomic Lua transactions, pub/sub wake-ups, cluster-ready keys.
MongoDB storage for Masterly.NightShift background jobs, on the official driver. Multi-document transactions on a replica set, TTL indexes for expiration.

Entity Framework Core storage for Masterly.NightShift background jobs: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL and other relational providers. Stage jobs in your DbContext so they commit with SaveChanges.
Masterly.NightShift for the generic host: dependency injection, ILogger logging and the job server as a hosted service, for Worker Services and console apps.
Masterly.NightShift for ASP.NET Core: the dashboard as an endpoint or middleware, health checks, and /health and Prometheus /metrics endpoints.

Background jobs that work the night shift: fire-and-forget, delayed, recurring and continuation jobs for .NET, stored in SQL Server, with a dashboard. Installs the core library, SQL Server storage and the ASP.NET Core integration.
APIMatic-generated .NET SDK for the Square API, one version per real Square API release (benchmark build, not Square's official SDK).
Roslyn source generator that records a project's Entity Framework Core model so AspireC4 can draw a d2 ER diagram from it.
Build-time EF Core model dump for AspireC4's d2 ER diagram. Reference it from the project that owns the EF Core provider to have the real model written to obj/ for the AppHost to read.
Zero-dependency C# source and JSON reference mapping shared OEM plastics and graphics kit templates across 175 dirt bike model years (76 models across 11 brands).
Zero-dependency C# source and JSON catalog covering 33 motorcycle helmet shell silhouettes, sun peak and chin bar traits, 6 paintable UV zone keys and 5 surface finish presets.
